Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 The role has no right on the operation (X2)
    Given the role does not hold the Treatment and offer right of the route operation
    When the route operation is called
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read, any agent call or any write, and no record is written

  Scenario: AC4 The agent answer is not usable (X3)
    Given the agent answer fails the allowed-action check, names a route outside the open set, or falls below the confidence threshold
    When the step checks the answer
    Then the step applies the rules in force and records the fallback
    Then where the rules give no answer the case goes to the owner's queue with the reasons

  Scenario: AC5 The agent does not answer in time (X4)
    Given rwb-agent does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the step calls the agent
    Then the step applies the rules in force and records the fallback
    Then the case is not blocked on the agent

  Scenario: AC6 The data product is stale (X5)
    Given the ACE data product is stale after a late or failed batch
    When the step reads the score
    Then the step holds, writes nothing and shows MSG-P1-001 with the data date
    Then the step resumes on a fresh answer

  Scenario: AC7 A route has no return (X6)
    Given a route of the open set has no COLLINS return, or its range is absent
    When the routes are scored
    Then the route is listed as an alternative without a figure and is not ranked on an invented number
    Then the gap is named in the reasons with MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC8 The case is not at the decision or a route is barred (X7, R-RES-32)
    Given the case is not at the route decision, or a route of the recommendation is barred on the case
    When the assessment is submitted
    Then the step does not recommend, writes nothing and reports the state to the parent

  Scenario: AC9 The same assessment is repeated (X8, R-UNI-40)
    Given the same assessment is submitted twice with the same Idempotency-Key
    When the second submission arrives
    Then the stored answer is returned with no second agent call and no second record
    Then the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed service does not answer (X9)
    Given rwb-source-data, rwb-agent, rwb-case or rwb-decision does not answer inside 2 s
    When the step reads from it
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow schedule and writes nothing
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC11 The boundary is crossed (X10, BR1, BR9)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC12 An event is published (BR10)
    Given the recommendation step has run
    When the outbox is checked
    Then no outbox row exists and no name is added to rwb.valuation.events.v1

  Scenario: AC13 Personal data enters a payload (BR4)
    Given the agent request, the decision record, a log or a workflow input is built
    When it is checked
    Then it carries identifiers, codes, amounts, dates and versions only, and no name, address, contact value, identity number or secret

  Scenario: AC14 A segment dimension changes (R-UNI-37)
    Given a segment dimension changes after a correction upstream
    When the routes are next scored
    Then the segment is recomputed and the gates are re-run

  Scenario: AC15 A new rule version reaches its date (R-UNI-38)
    Given a new rule version reaches its effective date
    When a decision is taken from that date
    Then the decision applies that version, and an open case keeps the version it was decided under

  Scenario: AC16 A person decides and names missing data (R-UNI-41)
    Given a person decides and names the missing data
    When the decision is recorded
    Then the case returns to the route decision and the rule gap is logged
